---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, improvement, or change in scope
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who experiences it and how often?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see. Be concrete: what command, flag, output, or behavior?

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried existing features, workarounds, or other tools? Why did they not fit?

## Scope

Which workspace does this touch?

- [ ] `apps/tolkin-cli` (CLI binary)
- [ ] `apps/tolkin-web` (web UI)
- [ ] `packages/tolkin-core` (Rust core or WASM)
- [ ] `distribution/` (Homebrew, action, skills)
- [ ] CI workflows

## Additional context

Relevant prior art, links, or sample inputs and outputs.
